links.outcome: Readability indices of radiology reports before versus after LLM simplification under three prompts
links.effect: All four LLMs significantly simplified 254 reports on four readability indices; performance varied by prompt and model, and ChatGPT models did best with added context such as a 7th grade target.
links.quote: All LLMs significantly simplified the reports, but performance varied based on the prompt used and the specific model.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering with user role or target reading grade level to improve LLM simplification of radiology reports

links.effect: LLMs effectively simplified radiology reports, but improvements were needed for accurate clinical representation and optimal readability.
links.quote: Our findings suggest that LLMs can effectively simplify radiology reports, although improvements are needed to ensure accurate clinical representation and optimal readability.

links.outcome: Readability under patient or grade-level prompting
links.effect: ChatGPT models performed best when specifying user as patient or requesting 7th grade level.
links.quote: The ChatGPT models performed best when additional context was provided (i.e., specifying user as a patient or requesting simplification at the 7th grade level).

links.effect: All LLMs significantly simplified reports across 4 readability indices, but performance varied based on the prompt and model used, with improvements needed for optimal readability.
links.quote: All LLMs significantly simplified the reports, but performance varied based on the prompt used and the specific model.

unlisted_practices: Using large language models with contextual prompting (specifying patient user or target reading level) to simplify radiology reports for patients
